title: High Protein Pasta! (50g PROTEIN) 🍝
description:
My favorite protein pasta.

Recipe link in bio!

I’ve been seeing @stealth_health_life make blended cottage-cheese sauces quite a bit over the years, and I’ve made a few myself, all incredible.  Definitely check his page for all things macro-friendly. Since I like to eat macro-friendly, “indulgent” meals on the weeknights, this kind of dish is the perfect way to trick yourself into thinking you’re eating something unhealthy.  I came up with this version to mimic rigatoni alla vodka with stracciatella, and I’m telling you, it will blow your mind.  You can eat this 3 times a day and only consume ~1800 calories, while eating 150g protein. (Obviously, you’d get sick of it pretty quick though). I recommend freezing the meal-prepped portions to eat whenever over the next few weeks/months, and just reheating in the microwave. It tastes just like the fresh version after freezing and reheating, but it also holds up great for about 4 days in the fridge. 

Genuinely the best, most convincing, “indulgent”, meal prep-able, macro-friendly pasta dish I’ve ever tried.

Note: these macros include an extra 20g cottage cheese & 5g parmigiano for garnish, but not the olive oil drizzle!

1 serving (makes 5):
586 Cal
51g Protein
62 Carbs
17 Fat

#sauce #cottagecheese #healthy #mealprep
